verdict.rationale: Together AI's first-party batch docs describe asynchronous batch workloads at "up to 50% lower cost" and "up to 50% off serverless rates", with a separate rate-limit pool. A documented CLI submit command (`tg batches submit`) shows how jobs are submitted. The discount is stated as "up to" rather than a fixed figure, and nothing outside the vendor's docs confirms it. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of batch job submission and the realized discount, and per-model batch pricing detail.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can submit asynchronous batch inference jobs at a documented discount versus real-time pricing

citations.quote: Run asynchronous batch workloads at up to 50% lower cost.
You get up to 50% off serverless rates and a separate rate limit pool, in exchange for a job-shaped (rather than request-shaped) workflow.
